biography:
With over 25 years of experience in the data center industry, I am a Senior VP at Bank of America, responsible for the evolution of the global strategy for the bank's changing data center portfolio and the operations of the Americas' data centers. I oversee all aspects of the data center facilities, including their design, physical security, operational excellence, and environmental, social, and governance (ESG) targets. I also manage the budgeting, KPI creation, and oversight of collocation providers and internal teams.

My mission is to align the business needs of the bank with the technologies and services that support them, while ensuring the highest standards of quality, reliability, and resilience. I have a proven track record of delivering critical technology services to business customers, managing enterprise systems, data center infrastructure, operation, construction, and design. I have also successfully led multiple, consecutive, data center design and construction projects worth over $1 billion, meeting aggressive timelines and demand growth. I am a strategic leader, a team builder, and a continuous process improver.
